release.content: pubdeploy 0.4.4 was released on 2026-11-17 from commit 5bffbd702ad9eb8860edc31ecf1f3f523b4cb77d with these changes.

rows: bitwarden.adopt is one of pubsec's types, so a block naming it without pubsec in deploy.providers says so

k8s.job-once: a one-off Job (a backfill, a migration) made from a CronJob's template or a manifest, with args and a timeout, run once; ready when it completed, unknown while it runs, drift when it failed, made again only with rerun: if-failed, and the plan names the Job a rerun deletes
